## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: objectstack-ai/objectstack `main` @ `0c2aeb96` (2026-11-14 21:16Z; 18.4.0 = tag `181ad7d4`). The console under `/_console` was built in the same tree from `ui/` (`pnpm console:build`, 22:02–22:08Z), so the console source is the same sha.
- App: `examples/app-showcase` (dist compiled once by the tree build), booted per item with `objectstack dev --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch`, own `OS_PORT` and own file DB under `/tmp/qa3/{A,B,C}/`; scratch app copies under `/tmp/qa3/B/ws` for every CLI / ceremony / datasource leg. Ports 41100–41159. Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai) + showcase personas; walled `isolated` / `group` boots via `scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs walled-boot`; Postgres via `qa-fixture.mjs external-database`.
- Runner: one Claude Code cloud session (thread runner for qa#3), 3 parallel runner subagents (effort high): A api 12 · B cli+mixed 7 · C browser 5. Node 22.23.4, pnpm 10.31.0, Playwright chromium (container build).

## Per-clause verdict tables

- Comment 1 (`record-P0-clauses-1.md`): runner group A — the 12 api items.
- Comment 2 (`record-P0-clauses-2.md`): runner groups B and C — the 7 cli/mixed items and the 5 browser items.

Tier 1 pins (all green, vitest `--maxWorkers=1`), each clause naming the layer its pin reaches:
- dogfood (HTTP, in-process `bootStack`) 18 files 306/306; objectql (engine) 4 files 251; plugin-security (plugin unit + engine) 23 + 6; rest 6 + 16; runtime 5 files (4/12/12/19/32) + boot-guard 42; plugin-auth 57; mcp (plugin unit) 27; cli organization-ownership + reactions 190; plugin-security authz identity-objects 3.
- `objectstack verify --rls` (showcase): RLS per-persona line `21 PROVEN (21 consistent, 0 HOLES) · 3 NOT PROVEN (… 3 skipped)`; position personas `38 PROVEN (38 consistent, 0 HOLES)`; CRUD tail `15 verified, 0 FAILED`.
- `examples/app-showcase/e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts` against an own boot: `50 passed (2.5m)`.
- Where a pin stops above a clause's oracle layer, the live leg was driven by hand (RUNNER rule 6); every cli/mixed live leg was driven on a scratch copy.

## Failures

None. No `fail` clause, so no reproduction rules and no extraction. No regression versus 18.4.0. No security finding.

## Derived item verdicts and gaps

- 22 PASS, 2 PARTIAL. Both partials are pre-existing, already-tracked dependency gaps, not regressions:
  - `access-security.rls-both-sides` · acceptance[5] · blocked{dependency, knownGaps[0] / #22017 row 11}: the D11 spot-check needs the maintainer-held private write-up; the clause's skip-explanation half passes (3 skips each explained: showcase_project_membership "no plain-text probe field", showcase_ext_customer / showcase_ext_order "external read-only object (federated datasource)").
  - `access-security.crud-permission-matrix` · acceptance[5] · blocked{dependency, #23267}: no door binds a permission set to the guest anchor (knownGaps[2]).
- Fixture notes: `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics` knownGaps[3] still open (logout row tenant_id NULL for producer (2) on `isolated`) — recorded, not scored. Two fixture writes outside HTTP that the items allow (org-scoped `manage_metadata` and `manage_sharing` grant rows) are recorded in the clause tables.

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

About 75 minutes in total across the 24 items (2–6 min each), on the same boots and personas: unknown / empty / missing ids on by-id, bulk (`createMany`/`updateMany`) and delete doors; opposite verb and opposite posture (walled `group` beside `isolated`, member beside admin, uninvited sign-up, `os serve` beside `os dev`); empty-string and out-of-range CLI flags (`-d ""`, `-p 70000`, `-d foo://bar`); filter / aggregate by an FLS-masked field over MCP and REST (refused 403, no filter oracle); readers outside scope on approvals, metadata and settings doors; clone overrides (forced and colliding id → 409 `UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, nothing written). **Findings: none that passes the filing gate.** Observations only (wording / cosmetic, not filed): `admin/create-user` on `single` answers `membershipCreated:false` while a `sys_member` row appears ~23 ms later; a seeded `f_tags: []` reads back `null`; `os dev -d ""` is silently "nothing chosen"; the `-d memory://` refusal calls the value "an OS_DATABASE_URL" even when it came from `-d`; MCP input-schema hint "Did you mean `filter` → `where`?".

## Checklist-accuracy notes (for the wave anchor, not extracted)

- `platform-core.seed-integrity` steps[1] still states the old baseline (invoice_line 7, 138 rows); at 0c2aeb96 the artifact authors 10 lines / 141 rows — the run used the re-derived values.
- `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals` acceptance[1] lists `os dev` among the development boots whose refusal shows `--dev`; in practice `os dev` catches the refusal and runs the ceremony itself after a backup (ADR-0131 D10 development exception, `dev-organization-ownership-upgrade.ts`); only `os serve --dev` shows the operator-facing `--dev` refusal.
- `cli-18-prerelease-db` recipe knownGaps[4] is stale: the restore now re-dates the shard (`sys_activity__r20261027 → __r20261113`), so the refused first boot and the apply keep all 66 rows; the second served boot then empties the shard by 14-day retention (rows' own timestamps), not by the apply.
- `scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs`: the `fixture.json` it writes lacks the `organization` key its stdout JSON carries.
- `records-forms.crud-roundtrip`: the record's own menu must be targeted inside `main header` (sidebar "More actions for …" buttons share the name); after a delete the list keeps its quick-search filter across navigation and reload.
